_: jaws_le on JPSalas & marty's 'JAWS 50th Anniversary' 3.2, a scripted original:
vpxshadow.py keeps its script as a shadow game and hands the ball to the real
game. The LE card, not the Pro: the table has the LE's fourth flipper (the upper
one, LeftFlipperG, on the right button as Stern's UP P/F R FLIP is) and its shark
rising out of the lagoon. PAD-1311: the shark shows while the machine's SHARK UP-MAG
is made (PAD-1339: the tribute's pop-up targets in front of it stay down; SHARK HIT is the
newton ball in its mouth being knocked; PAD-1374: CHUM BUCKET TGT is the other one, JP's captive ball at
CaptiveKick1, knocked at any angle, not the first chum drop target it had to reach), and the fin is the chum line's seven targets,
the one at SHARK POSITION 1..7 standing while SHARK FIN UP/DOWN holds it up.
The five shark-shaped shot arrows (Lnight) are the beaches' RGB; JP's fireball bulbs
over the shark (fcroco) stay dark. PAD-1331: the middle lane's own trigger (Target2) is CENTER RAMP MADE
(Tcloseshark sits on the shark's return wire above it), JP's reel in THE POND's U-turn (Spinner2) is the
FISHING REEL MAG SW the machine counts its reel's turns on, and the sling GI bulbs' outlines are round
(round_lights): boxy ones cut their glow into a square over each sling. The lower playfield's inserts sit where Stern's do (the drawing fits
X = (x - 15) * 3.34, Y = (y - 15) * 3.13 below the boat); the upper third is JP's
own layout, so the switches up there are matched by what the script does with
them and the GUESS ones want a look at the machine. The table has no eject coils
(neither has the machine): its kickers keep their own script (orig_keep).
Ids: the RIG's switch_list.txt for jaws_le; coils through group_node.txt (group
7 = node 8, group 8 = node 9).
GI: the LE names no playfield GI LEDs, so the table's own GIUpdateTimer keeps its
GI on (not quieted); its attract shows, rainbow and insert effects are.
PAD-1366: the far right lane (EAST BEACH, Raft Attack) is the machine's RIGHT RAMP. JP raises a ramp in it (Ramphouse) at every
ball, so each shot climbs into Krampquint, which re-makes the ball at Krampquint1 on the left ramp's return wire (Ramp051);
it falls into Quint's hole (PyramidKicker) and on over LeftRampDone. Nothing in the lane was a switch, so the game heard a
LEFT RAMP. Krampquint is RIGHT RAMP MADE now and that ball's LeftRampDone is let by (unless PadQuintBall()). RightRampDone,
the top of the upper deck's helix (Ramp025/Ramp026, from the deck the upper flipper plays), is UP PF RAMP MADE, not the right
ramp; sw5 (under the deck, the top of JP's orbit) no longer stands in for it. JP's spinner at the lane's mouth (Spinner1 and
its bracket Primitive89) is not on Stern's game: off the table.
PAD-1392: the inlane posts (RT/LT INLANE UP POST, JP's lockpostD/lockpostG) catch the ball. The game raises one when the ball
rolls over that lane's RETURN LANE switch with the harpoon (or a post hold) lit; the round trip to the emulated machine is
slower than the ball, which was past the post by then, so the harpoon ran with the ball already on the flipper. A post going
up within 800 ms of its lane's switch puts that ball back where it rests against the post, if it has gone past it.
The fin is ONE drop target sliding along the chum line (PadFin: a primitive with JP's fin target's look, Visual Pinball moves
a primitive but bakes a drop target's place in), at the place the emulated motor reports (Controller.GetMech(0), the shim's
end-stop motor place in thousandths of an input bit); JP's seven chum line targets are its unseen physics: PAD-1460, each within 3/4 of a position of the fin stands, so mid move it is covered.
The far right ramp's ball rolls on down the top wire: JP's Quint hole (PyramidKicker), which held it up to 3.5 s and kicked it
out, is off (Stern's game has no eject there), and Krampquint1 hands it on at 6, not 5.
PAD-1413: the Marina lane (Beach Panic, the lane under Lpanic left of the middle one) is the machine's LEFT RAMP. On JP's
table it is his orbit: up past Lpanic over sw9, under the deck to sw5 at the top of the climb, over the top past
Tbeach2/Tpanic and down the far right. Neither was a switch (sw5 had stood in for UP PF RAMP MADE until PAD-1366, sw9 ran
JP's skill shot), and LEFT RAMP MADE's LeftRampDone only ever saw the far right ramp's ball, which PAD-1366 lets by: no
shot reached the game as the left ramp. sw9 is LEFT RAMP ENTER and sw5 LEFT RAMP MADE now, each for a ball going up the
lane only (`up`): the plunge and other balls coming round the top the other way roll down the lane over both, and are not.
PAD-1431: Beach Panic goes up the wave ramp, and the center ramp turns round on a wire form (Mike, with photos of the
machine). JP's wave ramp is the channel at the top his middle lane ran into (Wall031/Wall034): KrampBoucle at its foot
kicks a ball up the unseen curl at its end (Primitive001), which turns it back over onto Ramp015 and down to the deck.
A Beach Panic ball (up over sw5) rolls on round the orbit; at Tpanic's place (PadWaveIn, a trigger of the map's own) it
drops into KrampBoucle. The center ramp's ball still goes to Kpiste and down the return wire (PAD-1425); PadMidTurn, a
4-wire copy of that wire (retrofit_ramps), curls from the lane's bend at Target2 round the corridor's mouth and back
under the deck to the wire's head, so the shot is seen to turn round where the lane used to lead on to the wave ramp.
It is drawn only (no collision): the corridor behind it is still JP's, and a ball the kicker fails rolls back out.

extra_vbs:
' PAD-1362: the return lanes, spotlights and Orca board light JP's lanterns and flashers, not stand-ins on bare art
' the quickshot lane's four triggers are the machine's switches: always live
Tquick1.Enabled = 1 : Tquick2.Enabled = 1 : Tquick3.Enabled = 1 : Tquick4.Enabled = 1
' PAD-1392: the inlane posts hold the ball the game holds. Stern's game raises LT INLANE UP POST on the shots that come
' back to the left inlane on the machine (CENTER RAMP MADE, the left orbit's QUICKSHOT TOP, the quickshot lane's QUICKSHOT
' BOTTOM: the harpoon and the modes' post holds) and RT INLANE UP POST on RIGHT RAMP MADE; it never reads the return lane
' switches for them. A ball that crossed a lane trigger (the quickshot lane's, a return lane's) within 800 ms of its post
' going up and is past the post by then is put back where it rests against it: lane i 0 left (lockpostG), 1 right (lockpostD).
Dim PadInBall(1), PadInAt(1), PadPostIsUp(1), PadPostX, PadPostY, PadLaneX, PadLaneY
Set PadInBall(0) = Nothing : Set PadInBall(1) = Nothing : PadInAt(0) = -100000 : PadInAt(1) = -100000
PadPostIsUp(0) = False : PadPostIsUp(1) = False
PadPostX = Array(221, 660) : PadPostY = Array(1661, 1664)   ' each post's centre
PadLaneX = Array(135, 732) : PadLaneY = Array(1538, 1548)   ' its lane's switch, up the lane from it
Sub PadInlane(i) : Set PadInBall(i) = ActiveBall : PadInAt(i) = GameTime : End Sub
Sub PadPostL(e) : lockpostG.IsDropped = Not e : PadPostCatch 0, e : End Sub
Sub PadPostR(e) : lockpostD.IsDropped = Not e : PadPostCatch 1, e : End Sub
Sub PadPostCatch(i, e)
	Dim b, bx, by, dx, dy, n, along, across
	If CBool(e) = PadPostIsUp(i) Then Exit Sub
	PadPostIsUp(i) = CBool(e)
	If Not PadPostIsUp(i) Then Exit Sub
	If PadInBall(i) Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
	Set b = PadInBall(i) : Set PadInBall(i) = Nothing
	If GameTime - PadInAt(i) > 800 Then Exit Sub
	On Error Resume Next
	bx = b.X : by = b.Y
	If Err.Number <> 0 Then Exit Sub   ' the ball is gone
	On Error Goto 0
	dx = PadPostX(i) - PadLaneX(i) : dy = PadPostY(i) - PadLaneY(i) : n = Sqr(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	dx = dx / n : dy = dy / n   ' down the lane
	along = (bx - PadPostX(i)) * dx + (by - PadPostY(i)) * dy
	across = Abs((bx - PadPostX(i)) * dy - (by - PadPostY(i)) * dx)
	If along < -10 Or along > 300 Or across > 200 Then Exit Sub   ' not past the post, or far off it
	b.X = PadPostX(i) - 38 * dx : b.Y = PadPostY(i) - 38 * dy   ' resting on the post
	b.VelX = 0 : b.VelY = 0 : b.VelZ = 0
End Sub
' PAD-1425: the center ramp always comes back to the left inlane, as the machine's does. JP's middle lane, where CENTER
' RAMP MADE is (Target2), runs up onto the upper deck; PAD-1392 sent its ball back only when the left post went up within
' 1.5 s of the shot, so a later harpoon (the post already up, or raised later) let the ball go on up to the deck with
' nothing on the post. A ball going up the lane now always goes onto JP's center return wire (Kpiste on Ramp053, as his
' shark's ball goes), which ends in the left inlane: against the post when the game holds it, on to the flipper when not.
' The upper deck is the left ramp's now (Beach Panic, below).
PadMidTimer.Enabled = 0
Sub PadMidShot
	Dim b, vy, held
	Set b = ActiveBall
	On Error Resume Next
	vy = 0 : vy = b.VelY
	held = False : held = TimerQuick.Enabled   ' JP's shark quickshot holds a ball in Kpiste
	Err.Clear
	On Error Goto 0
	If vy >= 0 Or held Then Exit Sub   ' a ball coming down the lane, or Kpiste busy
	b.X = Kpiste.X : b.Y = Kpiste.Y : b.Z = 80   ' on the wire (55 high), in the kicker
	b.VelX = 0 : b.VelY = 0 : b.VelZ = 0
	PadMidTimer.Enabled = 1
End Sub
Sub PadMidTimer_Timer : PadMidTimer.Enabled = 0 : Kpiste.Kick 180, 10 : End Sub
' PAD-1431: Beach Panic goes up the wave ramp; the center ramp turns round on a wire form
' Beach Panic (the Marina lane, the machine's left ramp) goes up the wave ramp to the upper playfield. PAD-1425 put its
' ball straight onto the deck by JP's lock; on the machine it goes on to the right and up the wave ramp (Mike). JP's
' wave ramp is the channel at the top (Wall031/Wall034) his middle lane ran into: KrampBoucle at its foot kicks a ball
' (85, 30) up the curl at its end (Primitive001, unseen, 180 high), which turns it back over onto Ramp015 and down onto
' the deck (WallHautJaw, 110) at the upper flipper. A ball going up over sw5 (LEFT RAMP MADE, the top of the climb, under
' the deck) rolls on round JP's orbit to the right; at Tpanic's place, just over the channel (PadWaveIn), it drops into
' KrampBoucle and goes up. A ball coming round the orbit the other way (the plunge) goes on down the lane.
Dim PadMarinaT : PadMarinaT = -100000
PadWaveTimer.Enabled = 0
Sub PadMarinaUp
	Dim b, vy
	Set b = ActiveBall
	On Error Resume Next
	vy = 0 : vy = b.VelY
	On Error Goto 0
	If vy < 0 Then PadMarinaT = GameTime   ' going up the lane: on round to the wave ramp
End Sub
Sub PadWaveIn_Hit
	Dim b, vx
	Set b = ActiveBall
	On Error Resume Next
	vx = 0 : vx = b.VelX
	On Error Goto 0
	If vx <= 0 Or GameTime - PadMarinaT > 3000 Then Exit Sub   ' the plunge coming round, or no Beach Panic shot
	PadMarinaT = -100000
	b.X = KrampBoucle.X : b.Y = KrampBoucle.Y : b.Z = 25   ' in the kicker at the wave ramp's foot
	b.VelX = 0 : b.VelY = 0 : b.VelZ = 0
	PadWaveTimer.Enabled = 1
End Sub
Sub PadWaveTimer_Timer : PadWaveTimer.Enabled = 0 : KrampBoucle.Kick 85, 30 : End Sub   ' JP's KrampBoucle_hit kick
' ---- PAD-1311: the shark and the fin follow the machine
' The shark rises and sinks with the machine's SHARK UP-MAG / DOWN-MAG switches. The ball hits the shark itself
' PAD-1339: SHARK HIT is the newton ball in its mouth (JP's captive ball, made by CaptiveKick) being knocked while the
' shark is up. The tribute's four pop-up targets in front of it stay down: PAD-1311 stood two of them unseen at the
' ends of the SHARK! insert, and the ball bounced off nothing short of the newton ball.
' The fin is the tribute's seven chum line targets, one per SHARK POSITION 1..7 (switches 104 down to 98): the one
' where the fin is stands while SHARK FIN UP/DOWN holds it up, and a hit is SHARK FIN TGT.
Dim PadSharkUp, PadFinUp, PadFinAt, PadFins, PadFinSt(6), PadNewtonLook
PadSharkUp = False : PadFinUp = False : PadFinAt = 1 : PadNewtonLook = 0
' PAD-1374: the table's two newton balls, each counted when it is knocked from where it rests, at any angle:
' 0 the shark's, beside CaptiveKick (544, 485): SHARK HIT while the shark is up.
' 1 the chum bucket's, JP's captive ball at CaptiveKick1 (325, 582): CHUM BUCKET TGT. JP had it roll up its lane into the
' chum line's drop targets and only the first of them (Tchum1) was the switch: a knock off the straight never got there.
' A ball slowing at the top of its swing is not at rest: it is armed again only back within 8 units of its resting spot.
Dim PadNb(1), PadNbX(1), PadNbY(1), PadNbSlow(1), PadNbArmed(1), PadNbAtX, PadNbAtY
PadNbAtX = Array(544, 325) : PadNbAtY = Array(500, 582)
Set PadNb(0) = Nothing : Set PadNb(1) = Nothing
Sub PadNewtonTick   ' the newton balls: found once, before any ball is served
	Dim b, i
	If PadNewtonLook < 100 Then
		If PadNb(0) Is Nothing Or PadNb(1) Is Nothing Then
			PadNewtonLook = PadNewtonLook + 1
			For Each b In GetBalls
				For i = 0 To 1
					If PadNb(i) Is Nothing And Abs(b.X - PadNbAtX(i)) < 30 And Abs(b.Y - PadNbAtY(i)) < 70 Then
						Set PadNb(i) = b : PadNbX(i) = b.X : PadNbY(i) = b.Y : PadNbSlow(i) = 0 : PadNbArmed(i) = False
					End If
				Next
			Next
		End If
	End If
	If PadKnocked(0) And PadSharkUp Then vpmTimer.PulseSw 1081   ' SHARK HIT
	If PadKnocked(1) Then vpmTimer.PulseSw 1089   ' CHUM BUCKET TGT
End Sub
Function PadKnocked(i)   ' newton ball i knocked from rest: once a knock, however long it swings
	PadKnocked = False
	If PadNb(i) Is Nothing Then Exit Function
	Dim b, v, dx, dy : Set b = PadNb(i)
	v = b.VelX * b.VelX + b.VelY * b.VelY
	If v >= 1 Then
		PadNbSlow(i) = 0
		If v > 4 And PadNbArmed(i) Then PadNbArmed(i) = False : PadKnocked = True
		Exit Function
	End If
	PadNbSlow(i) = PadNbSlow(i) + 1
	If PadNbSlow(i) >= 10 Then PadNbX(i) = b.X : PadNbY(i) = b.Y   ' still for half a second: where it rests
	dx = b.X - PadNbX(i) : dy = b.Y - PadNbY(i)
	If PadNbSlow(i) >= 3 And dx * dx + dy * dy < 64 Then PadNbArmed(i) = True   ' still 150 ms where it rests
End Function
PadFins = Array(Tbeachfinal, Tnightfinal, Tbarrelshark, Tjackpot, Tsharkfinal, Thammerfinal, Tsmimerfinal)
Function PadSw(n)   ' the machine's switch plane; False when the controller cannot say
	PadSw = False
	On Error Resume Next
	PadSw = CBool(Controller.Switch(n + 0))
End Function
Sub PadFinUpDown(e) : PadFinUp = CBool(e) : End Sub
Sub PadStand(o, ByRef st, want)   ' a drop target held up (want) or down. st: 0 held down, 1 standing, 2+ knocked down that many ticks ago
	If Not want Then
		st = 0
		If Not o.IsDropped Then o.IsDropped = True
	ElseIf st = 0 Then
		o.IsDropped = False : st = 1
	ElseIf o.IsDropped Then
		st = st + 1
		If st >= 7 Then o.IsDropped = False : st = 1   ' up again 300 ms after the ball knocked it down
	Else
		st = 1
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadMechTimer_Timer
	On Error Resume Next
	Dim i, at, o, p
	If PadSw(1079) Then PadSharkUp = True
	If PadSw(1080) Then PadSharkUp = False
	If shark.Visible <> PadSharkUp Then shark.Visible = PadSharkUp
	For Each o In Array(Targetshark1, Targetshark2, Targetshark3, Targetshark4)
		If Not o.IsDropped Then o.IsDropped = True
	Next
	PadNewtonTick
	If Not Rsaveball.Collidable Then Rsaveball.Collidable = True   ' PAD-1339: JP's outlane save never opens
	at = 0
	For i = 1 To 7
		If PadSw(1105 - i) Then at = i
	Next
	If at > 0 Then PadFinAt = at
	p = PadFinMech()   ' PAD-1392: the motor's own place, part way between two positions
	If p > 0 Then PadFinAt = Int(p + 0.5) Else p = PadFinAt
	' PAD-1460: the fin seen glides between the seven targets that are its physics. Only the nearest one stood, so
	' half way between two positions the ball met nothing where the fin was and a target half a slot off took the
	' hit. Each target within 3/4 of a position of the fin stands: mid move both neighbours, the fin covered.
	For i = 0 To 6
		PadStand PadFins(i), PadFinSt(i), PadFinUp And Abs(p - (i + 1)) < 0.75
	Next
End Sub
' PAD-1366: the far right ramp is RIGHT RAMP MADE, its ball is no left ramp, the deck's helix is UP PF RAMP MADE, no right spinner
Dim PadQuintBalls, PadQuintAt : PadQuintBalls = 0 : PadQuintAt = 0
Sub PadQuintIn   ' JP's Krampquint, without its flash: the ball goes on from Krampquint1, over the left ramp's LeftRampDone
	PadQuintBalls = PadQuintBalls + 1 : PadQuintAt = Timer
	Krampquint.DestroyBall
	Krampquint1.CreateBall
	Krampquint1.Kick 270, 6   ' PAD-1392: on down the top wire with no hole to stop in
End Sub
Function PadQuintBall()   ' the far right ramp's ball crossing LeftRampDone (Quint's hole holds it 3.5 s at most): once each
	PadQuintBall = False
	If PadQuintBalls <= 0 Then Exit Function
	If Abs(Timer - PadQuintAt) > 12 Then PadQuintBalls = 0 : Exit Function
	PadQuintBalls = PadQuintBalls - 1 : PadQuintBall = True
End Function
' PAD-1392: the far right ramp runs through: JP's Quint hole on the top wire (PyramidKicker) caught the ball and kicked it out
' after up to 3.5 s; Stern's game has no eject there, and the ball rolls on over LeftRampDone and down the wire.
PyramidKicker.Enabled = 0
' PAD-1392: one fin glides along the chum line, as the machine's does. Visual Pinball bakes a drop target's place into it
' when play starts, so the fin seen is PadFin, a primitive with JP's fin target's look, slid to where the emulated motor says
' its car is (Controller.GetMech(0): thousandths of an input bit, 38000 at SHARK POSITION 1 .. 32000 at 7) and raised and
' lowered with SHARK FIN UP/DOWN. JP's seven chum line targets are unseen, the one nearest the fin standing as its physics.
Dim PadFinPX(6), PadFinPY(6), PadFinPR(6), PadFinZ0, PadFinZ, PadFinReady
PadFinReady = False
Function PadFinMech()   ' the fin's place, 1 (POSITION 1) .. 7, from the machine's motor; 0 while it cannot say
	Dim g : g = 0
	On Error Resume Next
	g = Controller.GetMech(0)
	On Error Goto 0
	PadFinMech = 0
	If g >= 32000 And g <= 38000 Then PadFinMech = 39 - g / 1000
End Function
Sub PadFinTimer_Timer
	Dim i, p, f, want
	If Not PadFinReady Then
		For i = 0 To 6
			PadFinPX(i) = PadFins(i).X : PadFinPY(i) = PadFins(i).Y : PadFinPR(i) = PadFins(i).Orientation
		Next
		PadFinZ0 = PadFin.Z : PadFinZ = PadFinZ0 - 52 : PadFinReady = True
	End If
	p = PadFinMech()
	If p = 0 Then p = PadFinAt
	i = Int(p)
	If i > 6 Then i = 6
	If i < 1 Then i = 1
	f = p - i
	PadFin.X = PadFinPX(i - 1) + (PadFinPX(i) - PadFinPX(i - 1)) * f
	PadFin.Y = PadFinPY(i - 1) + (PadFinPY(i) - PadFinPY(i - 1)) * f
	PadFin.RotZ = PadFinPR(i - 1) + (PadFinPR(i) - PadFinPR(i - 1)) * f
	want = PadFinZ0 - 52   ' down under the playfield, as a dropped target goes
	If PadFinUp Then want = PadFinZ0
	If PadFinZ < want Then
		PadFinZ = PadFinZ + 5
		If PadFinZ > want Then PadFinZ = want
	ElseIf PadFinZ > want Then
		PadFinZ = PadFinZ - 5
		If PadFinZ < want Then PadFinZ = want
	End If
	PadFin.Z = PadFinZ
	PadFin.Visible = (PadFinZ > PadFinZ0 - 52)
End Sub
' PAD-1392: the inlane posts catch the ball, one fin glides along the chum line, the far right ramp runs through
' PAD-1413: the Marina lane is the left ramp: sw9 LEFT RAMP ENTER, sw5 LEFT RAMP MADE, on the way up
' PAD-1425: the center ramp always comes back to the left inlane; Beach Panic goes up to the upper deck
' PAD-1356: the backboard sign and Quint's shack follow the machine; the Scars loop kicker is back
' PAD-1460: the fin's targets stand under the fin all along the chum line
